description: Constants both implementations must agree on. All numeric values are decimal strings; see AGENTS.md.

GRADIDO_CENT_PER_GDD.description: 1 GDD = 10000 GradidoCent. The money unit has exactly 4 decimal places.

MAX_CREATION_AMOUNT.description: Upper bound for a creation (contribution) amount: 1000 GDD.

CODE_VALID_DAYS_DURATION.description: Lifetime of a transaction link code.

MEMO_MIN_CHARS.description: A memo travels with the transaction and is re-validated by the dlt-connector.

MEMO_MAX_CHARS.description: Bound by the varchar(512) column the memo is stored in. Must not be widened here alone.

MESSAGE_MIN_CHARS.description: A person-to-person message carries no amount; a short reply must pass.

ABOUT_ME_MAX_CHARS.description: Stored in a text column. The limit is in characters, the column bound is in bytes — an emoji costs four.

THANK_YOU_CARD_MAX_FAILED_ATTEMPTS.description: Wrong PINs a single card survives before it is blocked. Counted on the card, not on the person.

THANK_YOU_CARD_CODE_MAX_CHARS.description: 'DK-' plus 32 hex characters. Bound by the varchar(40) column in thank_you_cards.

THANK_YOU_CARD_MEMO_MAX_CHARS.description: Equal to MEMO_MAX_CHARS today, but a separate decision: this one is bound by thank_you_card_payments.memo.

ALIAS_QUOTA_PER_WINDOW.description: Alias picks allowed per window. A brake against cycling through near-misses of a popular name to catch payments meant for its owner — not a tidiness rule. Counts picks, not renames: returning to a name already owned is free.

REDEEM_JWT_TOKEN_EXPIRATION_MS.description: 10 minutes. Legacy stored this as the string '10m'; expressed here as a number so both implementations parse nothing.

JWT_TOKEN_EXPIRATION_MS.description: 30 minutes. How long a login token stays valid, counted from the moment it was issued. A token is re-issued on activity, but only once per JWT_TOKEN_REISSUE_AFTER_MS, so a login ends between 29 and 30 minutes after the last request rather than exactly 30.

JWT_TOKEN_REISSUE_AFTER_MS.description: 1 minute. A request whose token is younger than this gets no new one: the login slides in whole minutes instead of on every request. It also bounds what a session carries -- one token per interval for as long as the session lives, so SESSION_HARD_TIMEOUT_MS / this + 1 of them -- and that bound is what makes it safe to keep them for the comparison that replaces verifying the signature. See gradido2 Architecture.md, Session cache.

DHT_BOOTSTRAP_DEFAULT_URL.description: Where a community bootstraps from when its operator configures nothing. Overridable, and any running community can serve the same route — this is the default, not the only entry point.
DHT_BOOTSTRAP_DEFAULT_URL.source: gradido2 — the community operated by the Gradido project

DHT_BOOTSTRAP_PEERS_MAX.description: How many peers peer.bootstrap hands out. Enough to join the network, few enough that the route is not an enumeration endpoint.
DHT_BOOTSTRAP_PEERS_MAX.source: gradido2 — libp2p, unlike hyperswarm, comes with no public network to join

MASTER_SEED_BYTES.description: Length of MASTER_SEED (secrets.json). Within SLIP-10's 16 to 64, and the size of an ed25519 seed.
MASTER_SEED_BYTES.source: gradido2 Architecture.md -- Peer network, Communities and instances

MASTER_SEED_PATH_DHT.description: The SLIP-10 index of the path segment `dht`, under which the dht-node identity is derived from MASTER_SEED: the word's ASCII bytes read as one big-endian number, 0x00646874. Hardened, as every derivation of gradido-blockchain-core is. The derived child's 32-byte seed is libp2p-ffi's node seed; its public key is the node key a delegation names. test-vectors/master-seed.json holds both implementations to it.
MASTER_SEED_PATH_DHT.source: gradido2 Architecture.md -- Peer network, Communities and instances

DHT_SHARD_COUNT.description: How many shard topics a community's transactions are spread over. A community's shard is sha256(DHT_SHARD_CONTEXT || community public key)[0] & (DHT_SHARD_COUNT - 1), so the count is a power of two and at most 256. A mirror subscribes to whole shards to follow many communities at once. Raising it is a network-wide decision with an overlap window, never a code update on one side.
DHT_SHARD_COUNT.source: gradido2 Architecture.md — Peer network, Mirror nodes, and the topics they follow

DHT_SHARD_CONTEXT.description: Prefix of the hash that puts a community into a shard. Fixed so that both node implementations put the same community into the same shard; the version in it is what a future shard layout changes.
DHT_SHARD_CONTEXT.source: gradido2 Architecture.md — Peer network, Mirror nodes, and the topics they follow

DHT_SHARD_TOPIC_CONTEXT.description: Prefix of the hash that turns a shard number into a topic key: sha256(DHT_SHARD_TOPIC_CONTEXT || shard byte). A separate prefix from DHT_SHARD_CONTEXT, so that a topic key is never a shard input and the two derivations cannot be confused.
DHT_SHARD_TOPIC_CONTEXT.source: gradido2 Architecture.md — Peer network, Mirror nodes, and the topics they follow

DHT_COMMUNITY_TOPIC_CONTEXT.description: Prefix of the hash that turns a community public key into its own topic key: sha256(DHT_COMMUNITY_TOPIC_CONTEXT || community public key). A community publishes into this topic only while somebody follows it, which is what makes mirroring a single community free for everyone else.
DHT_COMMUNITY_TOPIC_CONTEXT.source: gradido2 Architecture.md — Peer network, Mirror nodes, and the topics they follow

DHT_KAD_PROTOCOL.description: The Kademlia protocol both nodes speak, with {DHT_TOPIC} replaced by the DHT_TOPIC setting. The topic is in the name so that two networks -- staging and production -- never share a routing table.

DHT_ANNOUNCE_TOPIC.description: The gossipsub topic of the announcements, {DHT_TOPIC} as above.

DHT_ANNOUNCE_MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES.description: The largest announcement payload a node publishes or accepts. The frame around it -- version byte and the 136-byte delegation -- is not counted.

DHT_RPC_PROTOCOL.description: The one libp2p protocol every RPC travels on. libp2p-ffi's, not ours to rename: the operation is named inside the frame, which is why no per-operation protocol exists. The frame is libp2p-ffi's src/wire.rs.

DHT_RPC_MAX_REQUEST_BYTES.description: The largest RPC request payload a node sends or accepts, the frame around it not counted. Applied by both nodes.
DHT_RPC_MAX_REQUEST_BYTES.source: gradido2 Architecture.md — Peer network, Transports and relay

DHT_RPC_MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES.description: The largest RPC response payload. Applied by both nodes.
DHT_RPC_MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES.source: gradido2 Architecture.md — Peer network, Transports and relay

DHT_RELAY_MAX_RESERVATIONS.description: How many private nodes a public one holds a relay slot for at once. Applied by both nodes.
DHT_RELAY_MAX_RESERVATIONS.source: gradido2 Architecture.md — Peer network, Transports and relay

DHT_RELAY_RESERVATION_SECONDS.description: How long a slot lasts before the private node has to renew it. Applied by both nodes.
DHT_RELAY_RESERVATION_SECONDS.source: gradido2 Architecture.md — Peer network, Transports and relay

DHT_RELAY_CIRCUIT_SECONDS.description: How long one relayed connection may stay open. A call opens a new one when the last has closed. Applied by both nodes.
DHT_RELAY_CIRCUIT_SECONDS.source: gradido2 Architecture.md — Peer network, Transports and relay

DHT_RELAY_CIRCUIT_BYTES.description: How much one relayed connection may carry. At least one DHT_RPC_MAX_REQUEST_BYTES and one DHT_RPC_MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES with room to spare: a community without a URL is reached over relays alone, and a limit below a full exchange would make every large answer undeliverable. rust-libp2p's default of 128 KiB is sized for hole punching, not for carrying calls. Applied by both nodes.
DHT_RELAY_CIRCUIT_BYTES.source: gradido2 Architecture.md — Peer network, Transports and relay

DHT_RELAY_MAX_RESERVATIONS_PER_PEER.description: Slots one node may hold on one relay. Fast path only: js-libp2p's relay has no such limit, so a TypeScript relay is bounded by the others alone.
DHT_RELAY_MAX_RESERVATIONS_PER_PEER.source: gradido2 Architecture.md — Peer network, Transports and relay

DHT_RELAY_MAX_CIRCUITS.description: Relayed connections open at once. What a relay carries at most is this times DHT_RELAY_CIRCUIT_BYTES every DHT_RELAY_CIRCUIT_SECONDS. Fast path only: js-libp2p's relay has no such limit, so a TypeScript relay is bounded by the others alone.
DHT_RELAY_MAX_CIRCUITS.source: gradido2 Architecture.md — Peer network, Transports and relay

DHT_RELAY_MAX_CIRCUITS_PER_PEER.description: Relayed connections one node may have open at once. Fast path only: js-libp2p's relay has no such limit, so a TypeScript relay is bounded by the others alone.
DHT_RELAY_MAX_CIRCUITS_PER_PEER.source: gradido2 Architecture.md — Peer network, Transports and relay

DHT_RELAY_CIRCUIT_PEER_INTERVAL_SECONDS.description: New relayed connections per node: one every this many seconds, DHT_RELAY_CIRCUIT_PEER_BURST in reserve. Fast path only: js-libp2p's relay has no such limit, so a TypeScript relay is bounded by the others alone.
DHT_RELAY_CIRCUIT_PEER_INTERVAL_SECONDS.source: gradido2 Architecture.md — Peer network, Transports and relay

DHT_RELAY_CIRCUIT_PEER_BURST.description: The reserve of DHT_RELAY_CIRCUIT_PEER_INTERVAL_SECONDS. Fast path only: js-libp2p's relay has no such limit, so a TypeScript relay is bounded by the others alone.
DHT_RELAY_CIRCUIT_PEER_BURST.source: gradido2 Architecture.md — Peer network, Transports and relay

DHT_RELAY_CIRCUIT_IP_INTERVAL_SECONDS.description: New relayed connections per IP address: one every this many seconds, DHT_RELAY_CIRCUIT_IP_BURST in reserve. Fast path only: js-libp2p's relay has no such limit, so a TypeScript relay is bounded by the others alone.
DHT_RELAY_CIRCUIT_IP_INTERVAL_SECONDS.source: gradido2 Architecture.md — Peer network, Transports and relay

DHT_RELAY_CIRCUIT_IP_BURST.description: The reserve of DHT_RELAY_CIRCUIT_IP_INTERVAL_SECONDS. Fast path only: js-libp2p's relay has no such limit, so a TypeScript relay is bounded by the others alone.
DHT_RELAY_CIRCUIT_IP_BURST.source: gradido2 Architecture.md — Peer network, Transports and relay

DHT_CLASS_UNKNOWN.description: The peer class of a community nobody has classified yet -- every community until the federation role has looked at it. libp2p-ffi's LP2P_CLASS_UNKNOWN.

DHT_CLASS_WITHOUT_URL.description: A community with a valid delegation and no verified URL: cheap to create, so the strictest of the classified.

DHT_CLASS_WITH_URL.description: A community whose URL answered the federation handshake with the key it claims.

DHT_CLASS_OWN_INSTANCE.description: Another instance of this node's own community. Not limited: it synchronises.

DHT_CLASS_BLOCKED.description: Refused outright, whatever it asks. libp2p-ffi's LP2P_CLASS_BLOCKED.

DHT_LIMIT_UNKNOWN_PEER_PER_MINUTE.description: Inbound RPC requests a DHT_CLASS_UNKNOWN community may make, per node. A token bucket: this many a minute, DHT_LIMIT_UNKNOWN_PEER_BURST in reserve. A request over it is refused before the federation role sees it. A starting value, to be tuned under load.

DHT_LIMIT_UNKNOWN_PEER_BURST.description: The reserve of DHT_LIMIT_UNKNOWN_PEER_PER_MINUTE: how many requests may come at once after a quiet spell.

DHT_LIMIT_UNKNOWN_PREFIX_PER_MINUTE.description: Inbound RPC requests a DHT_CLASS_UNKNOWN community may make, per IPv4 /24 or IPv6 /56 -- not applied to relayed connections, whose visible address is the relay's. A token bucket: this many a minute, DHT_LIMIT_UNKNOWN_PREFIX_BURST in reserve. A request over it is refused before the federation role sees it. A starting value, to be tuned under load.

DHT_LIMIT_UNKNOWN_PREFIX_BURST.description: The reserve of DHT_LIMIT_UNKNOWN_PREFIX_PER_MINUTE: how many requests may come at once after a quiet spell.

DHT_LIMIT_UNKNOWN_GLOBAL_PER_MINUTE.description: Inbound RPC requests a DHT_CLASS_UNKNOWN community may make, for the whole class. A token bucket: this many a minute, DHT_LIMIT_UNKNOWN_GLOBAL_BURST in reserve. A request over it is refused before the federation role sees it. A starting value, to be tuned under load.

DHT_LIMIT_UNKNOWN_GLOBAL_BURST.description: The reserve of DHT_LIMIT_UNKNOWN_GLOBAL_PER_MINUTE: how many requests may come at once after a quiet spell.

DHT_LIMIT_WITHOUT_URL_PEER_PER_MINUTE.description: Inbound RPC requests a DHT_CLASS_WITHOUT_URL community may make, per node. A token bucket: this many a minute, DHT_LIMIT_WITHOUT_URL_PEER_BURST in reserve. A request over it is refused before the federation role sees it. A starting value, to be tuned under load.

DHT_LIMIT_WITHOUT_URL_PEER_BURST.description: The reserve of DHT_LIMIT_WITHOUT_URL_PEER_PER_MINUTE: how many requests may come at once after a quiet spell.

DHT_LIMIT_WITHOUT_URL_PREFIX_PER_MINUTE.description: Inbound RPC requests a DHT_CLASS_WITHOUT_URL community may make, per IPv4 /24 or IPv6 /56, as for UNKNOWN. A token bucket: this many a minute, DHT_LIMIT_WITHOUT_URL_PREFIX_BURST in reserve. A request over it is refused before the federation role sees it. A starting value, to be tuned under load.

DHT_LIMIT_WITHOUT_URL_PREFIX_BURST.description: The reserve of DHT_LIMIT_WITHOUT_URL_PREFIX_PER_MINUTE: how many requests may come at once after a quiet spell.

DHT_LIMIT_WITHOUT_URL_GLOBAL_PER_MINUTE.description: Inbound RPC requests a DHT_CLASS_WITHOUT_URL community may make, for the whole class. A token bucket: this many a minute, DHT_LIMIT_WITHOUT_URL_GLOBAL_BURST in reserve. A request over it is refused before the federation role sees it. A starting value, to be tuned under load.

DHT_LIMIT_WITHOUT_URL_GLOBAL_BURST.description: The reserve of DHT_LIMIT_WITHOUT_URL_GLOBAL_PER_MINUTE: how many requests may come at once after a quiet spell.

DHT_LIMIT_WITH_URL_PEER_PER_MINUTE.description: Inbound RPC requests a DHT_CLASS_WITH_URL community may make, per node. A token bucket: this many a minute, DHT_LIMIT_WITH_URL_PEER_BURST in reserve. A request over it is refused before the federation role sees it. A starting value, to be tuned under load.

DHT_LIMIT_WITH_URL_PEER_BURST.description: The reserve of DHT_LIMIT_WITH_URL_PEER_PER_MINUTE: how many requests may come at once after a quiet spell.

DHT_LIMIT_WITH_URL_GLOBAL_PER_MINUTE.description: Inbound RPC requests a DHT_CLASS_WITH_URL community may make, for the whole class. A token bucket: this many a minute, DHT_LIMIT_WITH_URL_GLOBAL_BURST in reserve. A request over it is refused before the federation role sees it. A starting value, to be tuned under load.

DHT_LIMIT_WITH_URL_GLOBAL_BURST.description: The reserve of DHT_LIMIT_WITH_URL_GLOBAL_PER_MINUTE: how many requests may come at once after a quiet spell.

SESSION_HARD_TIMEOUT_MS.description: A SessionContext is dropped this long after creation regardless of activity. Backstop against cache-invalidation bugs, not a login timeout: a re-issued token copies session_created_at unchanged, so refreshing a login never extends a session. The login itself is JWT_TOKEN_EXPIRATION_MS.

ROLE_RIGHTS_CACHE_TTL_MS.description: Maximum age of the global role-rights cache. Invalidated early when an admin edits a role.

GLOBAL_CONTRIBUTION_CACHE_SIZE.description: Number of recent public contributions held in the AppContext.

MAX_RIGHTS_PER_DOMAIN.description: Rights of one domain are held in the bits of a uint64, so a domain cannot exceed this.

ARGON2ID_MEMORY_KIB.description: Memory for new password hashes, 32 MiB. Carried over from legacy so nothing gets weaker by accident — not chosen for gradido2. See types/PasswordHash.json, open.

ARGON2ID_PASSES.description: argon2id passes for new password hashes.

ARGON2ID_PARALLELISM.description: libsodium's crypto_pwhash fixes parallelism at 1; kept explicit so the PHC string is reproducible.
